Nutrition During Pregnancy

Each athletic woman experiences a pregnancy unique to her. Some feel
fine, eat well, exercise regularly, and breeze through the nine months of
pregnancy. Others experience fatigue, nausea, low-back pain, and other
discomforts. Some gain more weight than anticipated. Others gain accord-
ing to the standard guidelines. Eat according to your appetite, and trust
that regularly scheduled meals and snacks will contribute to the weight
gain appropriate for your body, the development of a healthy baby, and
the enjoyment of a comfortable exercise program. You will become fitter
and may reduce the risk of giving birth by cesarean section if you exercise,
but your weight changes will likely be similar with or without purposeful
exercise (Brik, Fernandez-Buhigas, and Martin-Arias 2018).
